result.rationale: In zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff shows refreshOAuthTokens called with `credentialId` as the third arg (`"zoho-bigin", credentialId`) while refreshOAuthTokens passes userId to the sync endpoint as `calcomUserId: userId.toString()`. All other call sites pass `credential.userId`. So in sharing mode the sync endpoint would receive the credential's id instead of the user id, causing wrong-user resolution or refresh failure. Verified directly in the diff.
